-------

R2 requires official template or three years revision history.

Withdrawals reset R3 venue clock to withdrawal rather actual presentation date.
Withdrawals do not count as acceptance under R4 rules.
R4 rejects prior round acceptances if fewer than 5 years elapsed since.
Exactly five years passes R4 check.
Paired submissions limited to two manuscripts, three prohibited.
Both paired manuscripts must satisfy R1 and R2 independently.
Pair requires at least one member to satisfy R3 requirement.

One endorsement insufficient Track D.
Retraction notice overrides all other rules including R9 figure adjustments.
Open retraction means manuscript not handled regardless conditions.
Figure counts range 8 to 45 inclusive standard submissions.
Paired submissions permit 70 figures max, min 8 applies.
Figures below minimum get padded verdict PADDED instead returned.
Figures exceeding maximum return outright rejected without padding opportunity.
Verdict PADDED only if R9 failure sole violation.
Failure elsewhere alongside figure shortage results in RETURNED verdict.
Track D exemption applies R2 only, no other exceptions granted.
R7 retraction check happens before any other rule logic.
Minimum page count satisfied by exactly 22 page submission.
Rejections occur if single violation exists across applicable rules.

Answer with exactly one letter: either "A" or "B".","role":"user"}],"model":"gpt-oss:120b","options":{"seed":1294944876,"temperature":0.7},"stream":false,"think":"medium"}
